description:
Location: crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/memory.rs:71-75

```rust
impl std::fmt::Display for MemoryError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "memory backend error: {}", self.0)
    }
}
```

The `JmapBackend::Error` associated type carries an explicit
security contract (crate-jmap-server/src/backend.rs:902-942):

> Implementations MUST NOT include any of the following in this
> type's `Display` output:
> - Credential material
> - Blob content — email bodies, sieve scripts, file contents
> - PII shaped like an email address

MemoryError's construction sites (memory.rs:248, 261, 263, 461, 479,
522, 532, 538, 540, etc.) wrap `serde_json::Error` via
`MemoryError(e.to_string())`. `serde_json::Error::Display` for parse
errors includes a snippet of the offending JSON. If a FileNode's
serialized form contains private data (filenames with PII,
shareWith principal addresses, vendor-private fields preserved by
the extras pattern), and the parse fails for any reason, that data
lands verbatim in operator logs.

Specifically, an attacker who can cause a parse failure (malformed
input that survives initial routing but breaks downstream
serialization, or a forced version-skew between sender and recipient
nodes) gets a log-side data-leak channel.

This is documented as a contract violation but the contract is
machine-unchecked — no compile-time enforcement. Two paths to fix:

1. **Sanitize at construction.** Every `MemoryError::from(e)` call
   site truncates and type-summarizes the inner error: e.g.
   `MemoryError("serde error at offset N".to_string())` instead of
   `MemoryError(e.to_string())`. This is the cheap fix and matches
   the section in the `JmapBackend::Error` doc.

2. **Audit at the type-derive level.** Add a unit test that
   constructs `MemoryError` with a canary literal (e.g. a UUID),
   formats it via `{}`, and asserts the canary does not appear.
   Pattern matches bd:JMAP-sc1b.79's per-type Debug-redaction
   canary applied to Display.

Propagation note: canonical sibling
`crate-jmap-mail-server/src/memory.rs:454-460` has the same Display
pattern. Both crates need the same audit; do mail-server first per
the canonical-template propagation rule.

This is api-contract,docs because the contract is declared in
prose but the implementation fails to honor it. The error type
itself is part of the public API; downstream impls will copy the
pattern.
title: MemoryError Display interpolates the raw inner string — violates JmapBackend::Error security contract
